Names of the selections that narrow the report

Source: R/report_selection.R
narrowing_selections.Rd

Names of the selections that narrow the report

Usage

narrowing_selections(analysis_params, data_selection)

Arguments

analysis_params

List returned by resolve_analysis_params().

data_selection

List returned by resolve_data_selection().

Value

Character vector of the data selections that are set and of the analysis selections that leave out some of their choices.
